lines: It's such a simple thing, so why can't I say it

you may be no different

There's a song only I can sing
There's a song only you can hear

The song I leave here is proof that I left it with you
I borrowed the strength to live, so I have to give it back while I'm alive
Only when you've forgotten your tears and your smiles
please remember
I lost my way in the same suffering
There's a song only you can sing
There's a song only I can hear
Everyone has someone they want to see. Everyone has someone waiting for them
If there's someone you want to see, then there's someone waiting for that
always

you may be no different
